summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers on install and require
details: @kibt/www-nuxt-i18n@1.0.0 is a no-op shim package (index.js exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for any accessed member) whose only effect is a reconnaissance beacon. The package.json postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and the main entry index.js invokes the same beacon on require(). beacon.cjs collects host identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, process.version via `os`, `process.cwd()`, `process.version`) and POSTs them to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The destination is unrelated to any publisher, is reached automatically on `npm install` and on any `require()` of the package, and the shim shape with no functional code is consistent with a dependency-confusion payload probing which environments resolve the scoped name @kibt/*.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
